summary: D006 succeeded at making a closed/open state-switch object, but the open state still appended the receipt to the surface rather than forcing an actual traversal. The closed lines have more tactility than D004-D005, yet the transform remains mostly an explanatory second layer.
strengths: The closed surface can be read without immediate procedural explanation.
The GLITCH acrostic and shadow sentence are mechanically stable.
The state-switch receipt made disclosure an operation rather than a mere label.
failure_modes: The reader opens the apparatus and receives appended triplets; little work is required beyond looking.
The open state still says what the project means instead of making the surface route the reader through a second state.
The apparatus is valid but remains more receipt than cybertextual path.
revision_decision: Revise into D007 as an ergodic traverse: selected final-word lengths route into omitted candidates, producing a second state and a route sentence.
quality_claim: No quality promotion. This is a cold craft diagnosis only.
